description: The capability milestones of docs/COMPLETION.md, in dependency order. tools/hstmilestones.py measures each one; a milestone is reached when its own criterion is 100% met, and the first date it was reached is kept in docs/milestones.json. Evidence milestones are reached only by an entry in 'evidence' naming a recorded scenario. Nakagawa Recomp covers what the decompilation cannot yet: its runtime is the platform layer and its recompiled code fills unmatched functions in the hybrid builds; knowledge flows both ways, code does not.

milestones.title: Every byte classified
milestones.criterion: every function boundary and every region of the six modules reviewed; no open candidate span

milestones.title: Game code matched
milestones.criterion: every function of EBOOT.BIN and the Sharing Version matches exactly (tier 1)

milestones.title: All code matched
milestones.criterion: every function of all six modules matches exactly (tier 1)

milestones.title: PSP rebuild
milestones.criterion: EBOOT.BIN and the Sharing Version rebuilt byte for byte from source by the whole-module build (Sony's library modules taken from the owner's disc)

milestones.title: Moddable PSP rebuild
milestones.criterion: the same two builds still load and run when relocated (tier 3): the game can be changed and rebuilt

milestones.title: Every module rebuilt
milestones.criterion: all six modules rebuilt byte for byte from source; no original binary is needed

milestones.title: Portable source
milestones.criterion: every source of the two game executables compiles with a host compiler for 32- and 64-bit Windows and Android targets, against the project's PSP platform headers

milestones.title: Platform layer
milestones.criterion: every PSP system function the game and its rebuilt modules import has a complete host implementation; the platform layer is Nakagawa Recomp's runtime (owner decision 2026-10-21), measured from its reviewed import audit

milestones.title: Plays on Windows, hybrid
milestones.criterion: a native Windows build where every matched function is compiled from this source and Nakagawa Recomp supplies the rest (recompiled code and its runtime) completes the documented scenario

milestones.title: Plays on Windows from source
milestones.criterion: a native Windows build from this source completes the documented scenario (boot, play a match, save, quit, resume)

milestones.title: Plays on Android, hybrid
milestones.criterion: the same hybrid build on Android completes the documented scenario

milestones.title: Plays on Android from source
milestones.criterion: a native Android build from this source completes the same documented scenario

milestones.title: Strict 100%
milestones.criterion: every gate of docs/COMPLETION.md holds for every byte of the six modules (tier 4)
